text:
maria_sales: Quick heads-up — SwissBank Inc wants a POC but requires processing + storage to remain in Switzerland only. Can we support CH-only for a short POC? They also asked for sub-processor names, DPA language, and a rough pricing delta. Timeline: 2 weeks.

sanjay_engineering: Short answer: Hosted API can’t guarantee physical CH locality today. Two practical options: 1) Dedicated (tenant-pin + region affinity) — best-effort toward CH edge, or 2) Private / on-prem with a local partner. We onboarded one finance customer with HelveticCloud previously. BYOK/HSM is common ask.

sanjay_engineering: Draft routing policy we can propose for the POC: `{tenant_pin: true, preferred_region: "ch-central", strict_residency: true, failover: "no_fallback"}` — this enforces tenant pin and disallows automatic failover to non-CH regions.

maria_sales: Ballpark numbers? Procurement wants an initial delta vs eu-central pricing so they can budget.

sanjay_engineering: Ballpark (preliminary): Dedicated CH = +20–40% infra premium vs eu-central (smaller regional pools + licensing). If BYOK/HSM required add ~+30% (integration + monthly HSM fees). Private/on-prem POC with HelveticCloud: estimated ~USD 15k–25k/month depending on instance shape and KMS. Can formalize in 48h after ops sizing.

claire_legal: They asked for sub-processor list, DPA text for data transfer basis, and certifications. Also flagged Schrems II and whether control-plane metadata leaves CH. We should answer control-plane telemetry scope for the POC.

noah_sre: Control-plane today for Hosted/Dedicated defaults to EU control-plane; we can minimise telemetry/metadata for the POC. For Private with HelveticCloud control-plane can be customer-hosted in CH VPC so nothing leaves Switzerland. Preview subprocessors for CH deploy: HelveticCloud (hosting), CloudNetCH (networking), Redwood-support (support ops). I'll prepare a redacted subproc list and attestations.

ops_bot: ticket created #POC-CH-789 — assignees @sanjay_engineering @noah_sre. Target: quote + subproc list in 48h :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria_sales: Awesome. I’ll update customer with the delta and ask whether BYOK/HSM is mandatory. Please attach the DPA snippet and the subproc link when ready.

sanjay_engineering: Preview links: https://redwood.example.com/subprocessors/ch — sample DPA snippet: `Data processing and storage for the tenant will be located in Switzerland. Control-plane telemetry will be minimised; customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM) required if requested.` I’ll DM the full legal export and formal quote once ops confirms sizing.

maria_sales: Thanks — keeping the customer posted. If they push for immediate Private deploy I’ll escalate. :thumbsup:
